prompt.content:
You are writing brief internal incident summaries for a synthetic enterprise-support dataset used to train and evaluate incident-correlation systems. For each incident in the input JSON array, write a 1-2 sentence SUMMARY an SRE would post in an incident channel: what broke, roughly how, and its user-facing effect. Do not invent additional root causes beyond what's implied by the fields given. Vary tone/length across incidents.

Respond with ONLY a JSON object: {"incidents": [{"i": <int>, "summary": "..."}, ...]} covering every index in the input, in any order.

[{'i': 615, 'component': 'Object Storage Service', 'region': 'global', 'severity': 'major', 'duration_minutes': 120}, {'i': 616, 'component': 'Alerting Engine', 'region': 'global', 'severity': 'critical', 'duration_minutes': 120}, {'i': 617, 'component': 'Job Scheduler', 'region': 'US-East', 'severity': 'major', 'duration_minutes': 120}, {'i': 618, 'component': 'Job Scheduler', 'region': 'EU-Central', 'severity': 'critical', 'duration_minutes': 60}, {'i': 619, 'component': 'Health Monitoring Service', 'region': 'global', 'severity': 'major', 'duration_minutes': 30}, {'i': 620, 'component': 'Vendor Integration Hub', 'region': 'global', 'severity': 'major', 'duration_minutes': 60}, {'i': 621, 'component': 'Job Scheduler', 'region': 'EU-West', 'severity': 'major', 'duration_minutes': 120}, {'i': 622, 'component': 'Ingress Controller', 'region': 'global', 'severity': 'major', 'duration_minutes': 30}, {'i': 623, 'component': 'Central Message Queue', 'region': 'EU-West', 'severity': 'major', 'duration_minutes': 300}, {'i': 624, 'component': 'Social Login Connector', 'region': 'APAC', 'severity': 'major', 'duration_minutes': 60}, {'i': 625, 'component': 'SSO Broker (Shared)', 'region': 'LATAM', 'severity': 'major', 'duration_minutes': 30}, {'i': 626, 'component': 'Report Subscription Service', 'region': 'LATAM', 'severity': 'critical', 'duration_minutes': 120}, {'i': 627, 'component': 'Social Login Connector', 'region': 'US-East', 'severity': 'critical', 'duration_minutes': 30}, {'i': 628, 'component': 'Load Balancer', 'region': 'US-West', 'severity': 'critical', 'duration_minutes': 30}, {'i': 629, 'component': 'Login Analytics Service', 'region': 'US-West', 'severity': 'major', 'duration_minutes': 120}]
